description.value: Ukee Scoops is an ice cream shop in Ucluelet, BC — 'Ukee' being the affectionate local shorthand for the town. The shop offers outdoor seating, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists passing through this gateway community to Pacific Rim National Park Reserve. It sits at the tip of the Ucluelet Peninsula, where touring routes converge after the scenic Highway 4 approach.

address.value: 1705 Peninsula Rd, Ucluelet, BC V0R 3A0, Canada
